name: Green Dragon Tavern
text: The Green Dragon Tavern was a public house located on Green Dragon Lane (today's Union Street) in Boston, Massachusetts. A popular meeting place for both the Freemasons and the Sons of Liberty, it was demolished in 1832.

depictions.name: Green Dragon Tavern
depictions.text: The Green Dragon Tavern was a small tavern located in Boston's North End.
